big_picture.title: Stock Market Rallies, Triggers This Shift; Jensen Huang Testimony, Jobs Report Loom
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market, including the Dow Jones index, ended a powerful rally week higher. Testimony from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang now looms.
paragraphs: The stock market ended a powerful rebound week sharply higher, which prompted a shift in recommended exposure. Testimony from Nvidia (NVDA) Chief Executive Jensen Huang and a new jobs report now loom. The Nasdaq gave the bears a black eye on Friday as it vaulted 2.3%. Nevertheless, the tech-heavy index remains in correction territory as it is still 12.6% off…
